name: Current versions of clinical guidelines
description: For each guideline: the current version, the previous version, the date we last checked it against the issuing organization, and where to get the full text. Guidelines on the same topic from China, Europe, the United States and international societies are listed side by side.
howToUse: To check whether a cited guideline is current, match the organization and topic, then compare the cited year or version with “version” and “previousVersion”. A citation that matches “previousVersion” cites an earlier version. When “previousVersionRelation” is “updates”, the current version changes only part of the earlier one, so both may be cited together.
Check “lastChecked” before relying on a record, and follow “officialUrl” to the issuing organization. The list records publication facts, not recommendations.

fullTextAccessValues.free: The complete guideline is free to read or download from the official source or a file linked from the official page.
fullTextAccessValues.summary-only: A summary has been published; the full guideline has not been published yet.
fullTextAccessValues.may-need-access: The full text may need a journal subscription or institutional access.
fullTextAccessValues.not-confirmed: Start from the official page. We have not confirmed free access to the full text; the site may ask for a sign-in or a browser check.

previousVersionRelationValues.replaces: The current version replaces the previous version.
previousVersionRelationValues.updates: This version revises part of the earlier guideline; the parts it does not revise still apply.
